== Notes ==
* To get the recharge effect, consider using this attack while [[line of sight]] is blocked. Momentarily switching to attack a [[block]]ing opponent or attacking whilst [[blind]] can give a good chance of getting the effect too.
** The Luxon/Kurzick skill [[Shadow Sanctuary]] and [[Signet of Midnight]] can inflict blind on the user.
